message: UFR-4 retry bound (the spec left the number to the plan) defaulted to 2 failed round-attempts before parking with the failure as the reason — chosen to match the owner convention of budgeting >=2x the worst observed transient while keeping a failed round from consuming a completed round under the 3-round cap. Reversible (a single constant); change before build if you'd prefer a different bound.

Tasks doc encodes the plan's NOTIFY-class UFR-4 default as a concrete constant DOC_ROUND_RETRY_ATTEMPTS = 2 (two failed attempts per doc-review round before parking; Task 22). This is a defaulted threshold the owner may want tuned before build — change the constant if a different retry budget is preferred.
